newsitem.title: USA: Digital Products says it may merge.
newsitem.headline: Digital Products says it may merge.

text.p: Digital Products Corp said on Tuesday it was engaged in strategic negotiations with Tracking Systems Corp (TSC) of Harrisburg, Pa., that could involve Tracking Systems acquiring Digital Products. "TSC is considering an investment in, or possible acquisition of, DPC and has agreed, subject to negotiating a consulting agreement, to provide advice to DPC on its monitoring operations and business development," Digital Products said in a news release.
Both companies make electronic-monitoring devices for prisons.

"The marketplace is seeking alternatives, and I believe that the combined efforts of both companies provide an optimum solution for the monitoring service and product needs of the corrections and criminal justice industry," John Sciortino, chief executive of TSC, said.
Digital Products also its president and vice president had resigned and been replaced and that two directors had also quit.
The company also said it has "suffered significant operating losses and is experiencing severe liquidity problems."
Digital Products, which issued no financial details, said it expected it would have to restructure its outstanding debts and was seeking additional financing. It gave no timetable for the actions.
